name: generated_tree_ownership
description: Hand root-owned generated Proto trees in the repository back to the operator, so unprivileged builds can replace them without elevating

storage.rationale: The safeguard creates no files. It changes the owner of existing generated Proto files and leaves their contents alone.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.evidence: Windows has no root-owned file case; generated files are written with the user's own ACLs.
